Emmet's Place

Paquito D'Rivera & Diego Urcola - Live From Emmet's Place Vol. 103 (2023)

January 2, 2023 · Harlem, New York

Watch on YouTube

Lineup

  • Emmet Cohen Piano
  • Paquito D'Rivera Saxophone & Clarinet
  • Diego Urcola Trumpet
  • Philip Norris Bass
  • Kyle Poole Drums

Setlist

  1. All The Things You Are (Jerome Kern; lyr. Oscar Hammerstein)
  2. Emmet Cohen Presenta a los Músicos:
  3. Un Respeto Mutuo
  4. Bebop (Dizzy Gillespie)
  5. Paquito reflects on the impact of Dizzy’s composition ‘Bebop’
  6. Paquito highlights the role of Brazilian music in the ‘jazz’ tradition.
  7. Manhã de Carnaval (from classic Brazilian Portuguese film ‘Black Orpheus’— Orfeu Negro) (comp. Luis Bonfá; lyr. Antônio Maria)
  8. Diego & Paquito reminisce on Dizzy’s performances of Manhã de Carnaval
  9. Paquito D’Rivera Recalls first encounter w/ Claudio Roditi, Brazilian valve trombonist // Diego Urcola shares a personal history with the valve trombone
  10. The Monster & the Flower (comp. Claudio Roditi, Ricardo Silveira)
  11. Paquito D’Rivera shares more about composer Claudio Roditi and Brazilian percussionist, Portinho
  12. Paquito D’Rivera fondly remembers Dizzy Gillespie, his support of musicians, his South Carolina roots, & famed composition ‘Birks Works’
  13. Birks’ Works (Dizzy Gillespie)
  14. Diego Urcola saluda a sus hermanos argentinos virtuales
  15. Alfonsina y El Mar (comp. Ariel Ramirez)
  16. Paquito D’Rivera shares the humorous unpredictability in the life of a musician.
  17. Alexander’s Ragtime Band, with intro (Irving Berlin)
  18. Paquito discusses tour with Diego & pianist Chucho Valdés, introducing his composition dedicated to Chucho “I Miss You Too”
  19. I Miss You Too (comp. Paquito D’Rivera)
  20. Paquito Recognizes Mario Bauzá as one of Harlem’s most influential figures // his impact on Dizzy Gillespie & bebop movement & role as musical director of the Machito orchestra
  21. Mambo Inn (comp. Mario Bauzá, Grace Sampson, & Bobby Woodlen)
